indications_and_usage: 1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE RHAPSIDO ® is indicated for the treatment of chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) in adult patients who remain symptomatic despite H1 antihistamine treatment. Limitations of Use: RHAPSIDO is not indicated for other forms of urticaria.
